about.what: Every way ZKRoto tried to turn the front.png pose into other camera angles, with its settings, data source, results joint by joint and PASS / FAIL. One file for all trials; the README only points here (user, voice 2026-11-09 22:0x).
about.check: Reference check: ZKRoto's POV of the FRA-007 front.png pose (atdd/fixtures/front_pose_face.json) at yaw 0 and 90, eye at chest height, 3 m, fitted onto MediaPipe's own result on front.png / side.png (atdd/fixtures/side_pose.json). Grid 20 x 30 over the 1024 x 1536 picture (51.2 px cells): a joint is right only in the same cell as the reference; near = one cell off; far = more. PASS = every joint of every layer in the same cell.
about.layers: op = OpenPose 18 (from MediaPipe 33), mp = MediaPipe Pose 33, face = OpenPose face 70 (from Face Landmarker 478; front only - no face is found on side.png).
about.rule: Values AND the reference pictures, every time (user 2026-11-09 21:3x). A trial that is not in this file did not happen.
about.seenInAll: In every re-run trial (T05-T12) the side view has the hips at the buttocks and the legs straight down, while side.png has the pelvis forward and the legs slanting back: that posture is not in the front picture; scaling MediaPipe's depth only trades lean against flatness.

trials.title: Face mesh fitted onto the pose's head points (best-fit similarity of 7 points: nose, eyes, mouth corners, ears)
trials.why: Face ~1.4 x too big, eyebrows in the hair, jaw line broken: the pose's head points have guessed depth and the pose ears sit wider than the mesh cheeks. Sent with only the body number (1.3 %), picture not looked at closely.

trials.title: Face depth anchored at the pose ears instead of the nose
trials.why: Side view: the near half of the face then sits about as far in front of the drawn profile as the nose anchor sits behind it.

trials.title: Character sheet: x / y from front.png, depth from side.png (MediaPipe on each)
trials.why: Seen (grid, 2026-11-10 07:0x): side - posture now matches side.png (head forward, legs slanting back, no lean); neck / shoulders 1 cell low, hips 1 cell high (side.png's MediaPipe puts shoulders higher and hips lower than front.png's). Front - hands 1 cell low: perspective of the 3 m camera (the drawing has none).

trials.title: Character sheet as T13, camera 5 m (less perspective)
trials.why: Seen: front - matches the drawing (largest offset 11 px, hands); face 70/70. Side - posture matches; the 4 off joints are all 1 cell vertical (neck / shoulders low, right hip / ankle high): the two pictures disagree on joint heights, one 3D body cannot match both. Best balance so far.

trials.title: Character sheet, height = mean of front and side, camera 5 m
trials.why: Seen: side - 15/16, neck closer. Front - shoulders visibly higher than the drawing, right ankle higher, face 64/70: the height disagreement is only moved from side to front. Not better than T14 overall.

trials.title: Character sheet, side picture fitted to the front heights joint by joint (least squares), camera 5 m
trials.why: Agreed by voice 2026-11-10 09:2x. Grid identical to T14; pictures (front + side, 07:4x) indistinguishable from T14. Why: the body's heights already come from front.png; only the depth scale changed (x 0.9944 vs 0.9810). After the best fit the two pictures still disagree joint by joint (px at 1536): left shoulder -31, right shoulder -16, left hip +24, right hip +31, right ankle -35 (hidden leg, visibility 0.62), left ankle +17. So the 1-cell vertical misses in the side view are the pictures' own disagreement, not something a process can remove without moving the front.

heightDisagreementPx.note: side.png joint height after the least-squares fit minus front.png joint height, pixels at 1536 high
